_comment_top: Example dispatch config for opencode_dispatch.py. Copy to <project>/.colosseum/dispatch.json and edit. Schema described in colosseum/scripts/opencode_dispatch.py.
_comment_canonical_panel: CANONICAL 5-VOICE PANEL for adversarial spec review. Each voice is pinned to the strongest variant of its family verified dispatchable at pin time (2026-07-11) with max thinking enabled. Pins drift, and `opencode models` lists catalog entries the provider may reject — probe with `opencode run --model <id> "Reply with exactly: ok"` before milestone runs. The Claude voice runs in-harness via the colosseum-spec-adversary Agent subagent (NOT through this script) — dispatch claude-agent separately alongside opencode_dispatch.py. The four voices below are the OpenCode-dispatched roster. For Lean-specific tasks substitute the local Leanstral voice (lmstudio/leanstral-2603; upstream discontinued 2026-06-30, Leanstral 1.5 is the successor for new installs).

voices.note: OpenAI frontier tier via OpenCode direct openai provider. Invoked at --variant max. Verified dispatchable under ChatGPT-account (Codex) auth, which rejects gpt-5.6-pro and the retired gpt-5.1-thinking; API-key installs may prefer openai/gpt-5.6-pro. Pro-tier reasoning latency is high — keep per_call_timeout generous.

Moonshot Kimi K2.6 via Burnt gateway (Cloudflare AI Workers). ReAct loop produces 6.8-15K-char per-slice reports. Reasoning is currently off on this route (gateway-controlled); if the gateway gains a kimi-thinking route, update this entry.
DeepSeek V4 Flash via local ds4 provider (DwarfStar4, http://127.0.0.1:8000). 400K context, reasoning on, q2-q4-imatrix quant. Invoked at --variant max.

Gemini 3.1 Pro (current Gemini Pro; gemini-3-pro-preview was retired 2026-03 and bare gemini-3-pro was never a valid API id) via OpenCode direct google provider. Invoked at --variant max. Requires GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY — without it every Gemini dispatch fails with an unregistered-caller error.

_comment_claude_voice: The fifth voice in the canonical panel is the strongest Claude available to the harness session, dispatched in-harness as `claude-agent` via the colosseum-spec-adversary Agent subagent. That voice does NOT run through opencode_dispatch.py — the Agent tool invocation happens from the Claude Code session that owns the adversarial pass. See SKILL Step 4 Mode 2.
_comment_excluded_voices: Voices known to fail adversarial spec review: glm-4-7-flash (degenerate loops at 30B 'flash' tier); goedel-prover-v2-32b and other theorem-prover specialists (treat prompts as proof goals instead of attack targets — use at verify-pyramid layer instead). leanstral-2603 belongs in Lean-specific verification work, not general adversarial spec review — substitute only when the spec is a Lean theorem.
_comment_dispatch_invocation: opencode_dispatch.py passes --format default to each `opencode run` call and appends --variant automatically: the per-voice `variant` field if set, else `default_variant` below. No script modification needed.
_comment_slices: Slice plan. Each slice is one (voice, slice) call. headers[] are the markdown header ranges the agent should read from the target spec. attack_emphasis is the per-slice attack-category hint. Replace this example with your project's actual sections.

slices.name: scope
slices.label: System identity, non-goals, external contracts
slices.attack_emphasis: Identity overreach; non-goals that should be in scope; caller-contract clauses that admit clients the doc intends to exclude.

slices.name: behaviors-core
slices.label: Worked examples — happy path, boundary, edge, explicit failures
slices.attack_emphasis: Worked-example arithmetic; edge-case completeness; explicit-failure listing completeness; happy-path implicit assumptions.

slices.name: invariants
slices.label: Structural and behavioral invariants
slices.attack_emphasis: Pointwise evaluability of state invariants; temporal-tag correctness; coverage gaps; derived-flag soundness.

_comment_context_appendix: Optional shared-context block prepended to every call. Use for type signatures, invariant labels, or cross-section glossary entries that are load-bearing but not under attack. Mark clearly as read-only / not-to-be-attacked.
context_appendix:
=== CONTEXT APPENDIX (read-only — DO NOT ATTACK; these sections are attacked in their own invocations) ===

System under review: <your system name and one-line description>.
Intent doc: version <X.Y.Z>.

=== END CONTEXT APPENDIX ===
_comment_variant: default_variant is passed as `--variant` to every voice that lacks its own `variant` field. Canonical setting is max (maximum thinking budget on every voice that supports it). A per-voice `variant` field overrides; set it to an empty string to omit the flag for that voice.
_comment_timeouts: per_call_timeout: seconds budget per (voice, slice) call. Local reasoning models on consumer hardware can take 10-25 min per slice. max_retries: per-call retry budget on truncated stubs or HTTP errors.
